---
title: "List page template"
description: "A list page: a page header with actions, and a DataTable with sorting, search, pagination, a loading state and an empty state."
---

A template renders `PageLayout`, fixes part of it, and exposes props for the rest. It is copy-code: the file is yours to edit.

## Preview

**Anatomy** names each slot and what fills it. The panel changes the props live; the fixed parts stay.

## How it uses the layout

The template fills these slots of `PageLayout`. Each slot is fixed by the template, filled by a prop, or not used.

<SlotMap layout="PageLayout" template="list-page" />

| Layout slot | Filled with | Fixed or prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PageLayout.header` | header layout | fixed |
| `PageLayout.header` | title, description, actions | prop |
| `PageLayout.content` | DataTable: sorting, search, pagination, empty and loading states | fixed |
| `PageLayout.content` | columns, data, filters, state | prop |
| `PageLayout.aside` | not used | – |

## Fixed and variable

**Fixed by the template** (edit the constants at the top of the file):

- Header layout
- Toolbar position for filters
- Empty state
- Loading state

**Props** (the variable part):

- `title`, `description`, `actions`, `filters`
- `columns`, `data`, `loading`, `manual`, `rowCount`
- `state` and the change handlers

## Install

<RegistryCommand name="list-page-template" />

## Code

The template is one file, and a page uses it. The page sets only what varies: no heights, no overflow.
